learning_outcomes.text: Make the students familiar with the basic methods and devices for electrical and non-electrical quantities evaluating as well as the metrical appraisals and results calculating.
Acquire skills and habits which might be needed in measurement schemes realizing and to solve particular problems as well as in students' activities as forth coming experts – electrical engineers.

syllabus_topics: A quality of the quantitative appraisals
Assigning values to the electrical and magnetic quantities
Electrical quantities measuring by immediate comparison
Quantitative analysis of non-electrical quantities by electrical methods and devices
System for ensuring the unity of the measurements
assessment_rules: Marking is realized by testing during tutorials and by periodical test control throughout the semester. The education concludes with an exam at the end of the third semester.
institution: University Of Ruse Angel Kanchev — Electrical Power Engineering (Bachelor)
